[seg_001] [00:00 - 00:04] SPEAKER_00: Alright team, let's start today's sprint sync on the NLP pipeline.
[seg_002] [00:04 - 00:09] SPEAKER_01: Sure. I finished benchmarking the Whisper-small model on our audio recordings yesterday.
[seg_003] [00:09 - 00:14] SPEAKER_02: Great! Did we decide on using Whisper-small or Faster-Whisper for production?
[seg_004] [00:14 - 00:21] SPEAKER_02: I propose we use Faster-Whisper with 8-bit quantization because it cuts latency by 40%.
[seg_005] [00:21 - 00:25] SPEAKER_00: I agree. We officially confirm Faster-Whisper with INT8 as our baseline.
[seg_006] [00:26 - 00:31] SPEAKER_01: Confirmed. Now, what about speaker diarization?
[seg_007] [00:31 - 00:37] SPEAKER_01: We are evaluating pyannote.audio 3.1. I can complete the benchmark by Friday.
[seg_008] [00:38 - 00:42] SPEAKER_02: Awesome. Please take ownership of that pyannote integration task.
[seg_009] [00:43 - 00:49] SPEAKER_02: For summarization, I might be able to deliver the comparison between BART and LED by Monday.
[seg_010] [00:49 - 00:55] SPEAKER_02: Let's make that a formal action item: deliver BART vs LED report by Monday.
[seg_011] [00:55 - 00:58] SPEAKER_00: Accepted. I will deliver the report on Monday.
[seg_012] [00:58 - 01:04] SPEAKER_01: One open question: are we deploying on AWS or GCP? That remains unresolved for now.
[seg_013] [01:04 - 01:08] SPEAKER_02: Right, cloud deployment provider selection is deferred until we get budget approval.
